requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: Designed and implemented acoustic beamforming algorithms for hearing-aid microphone arrays, targeting a 4-element MEMS microphone array on a behind-the-ear form factor.

requirements.note: The described beamforming work is for an acoustic microphone array, not the radar/sonar/comms arrays named as examples in the requirement description.

lines.quote: Developed and maintained embedded DSP firmware in C for TI C5500-series processors, implementing real-time audio processing chains with hard latency constraints under 5 ms
Built and maintained a Python-based production calibration pipeline that automates the characterisation of hearing-aid sensor boards on the manufacturing line.
Currently used by the production engineering team across two sites, maintained with unit tests and CI.

Carried out RF front-end characterisation and calibration for the company's wireless hearing-aid link receivers, using vector network analysers and conducted-emission test setups at the Tampere test facility
MSc Applied Physics, Tammerkoski University (formerly TTK), 2001

Contributed signal-processing algorithms for Vireo's participation in an EORA Aurelia Auxiliary Instruments subcontract, processing telemetry from an airborne validation flight campaign over Northern Scandinavia
